content:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran the end-to-end profiler across H100/A100/A10/L4/T4 after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Seeing a P50 regression for long-seq requests on H100 (~12% higher latency).
akash: Do we have flamegraphs or the OPS breakdown?
jun: I pulled the perf artifacts, short summary: more kernel churn during KV cache hits for long prefix lengths. Kernel warmups + extra small GEMM launches.
perf-bot: deploybot: kernel-selector v2.1.4 rolled at 1719122000 by @maria :rocket:
priya: Hmm. So batching heuristic is forming mixed-shape batches that trigger kernel recompile/selection mid-slice?
maria: Exactly. The selector now tries to aggressively pick faster kernels for short sequences; with mixed-length packing we flip between two kernels when a large kv-hit occurs -> extra latency.
akash: Can you paste the top-line numbers (P50/P95 tokens/sec or ms) for H100 vs baseline?
jun: baseline (v2.1.3): H100 long-seq P50=78ms, P95=240ms. after v2.1.4: P50=88ms, P95=260ms. A100 changed negligibly. L4/T4 got slightly better due to smaller kernel path wins.
priya: So H100 lost due to fragmentation. Any KV-cache metrics?
jun: KV cache hit path time increased ~18% for large KV usage. KV-fragmentation observed: more small cache entries, poorer locality.
maria: Proposed mitigation: 1) adjust max_tokens_per_batch targets per-card to reduce mixed packing on H100 (bias toward single-shape batches), 2) change queue policy to prefer packing with same kernel fit score, 3) add an H100-specific kernel_selector guard to avoid aggressive kernel flips for >2k KV tokens.
akash: Can we try concrete per-card targets? My rough proposal: H100=12000, A100=8000, A10=4800, L4=3200, T4=2500 (tokens-per-batch ceiling). Thoughts?
jun: Those look reasonable. For L4/T4 keep tighter to avoid latency spike. A10 sits between cloud GPUs and accelerator-class.
priya: I suggest we encode as "soft" targets first (queue-level bias) then hard caps only if we see packing still mixing kernels. Rollout plan: AB test traffic for 4h windows.
maria: Patch payload (snippet):
```
# runtime config snippet
batching: {
  token_budget_targets: { h100: 12000, a100: 8000, a10: 4800, l4: 3200, t4: 2500 },
  prefer_same_kernel_score: true,
  packing_policy: "shape-first"
}
kernel_selector: { h100_flip_guard_tokens: 2000 }
```
akash: Let's run a perf sweep: compare baseline vs (soft targets + prefer_same_kernel_score) vs (hard caps + flip_guard). Need P50/P95, KV hit latency, and token throughput.
jun: I'll schedule runs on staging cluster tonight. Will capture nyx profiler traces and the kernel-selection logs.
priya: Also flag in console: add per-route alert if packing-mix-rate > 10% on H100.
maria: Good. If results look good we can roll to canary for 6 hours and monitor console dashboards for regressions. Ping me when staging traces are up. :+1:
akash: Thanks — if jun needs extra capacity let me know, I'll spin up a few A100s.
jun: Will do. uploading trace tarball to /artifacts/1719123456/ now.
perf-bot: perf-alert: kernel-selector churn exceeded baseline by 2.3x for H100 on 1719123300 (auto-detected)
maria: Okay closing notes: prioritize H100 fix path, then tune remaining card targets. We'll reconvene after staging runs.
